ayahOccurrences.text: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّى مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّى مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: accusative masculine plural (form IV) active participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مُرْدِفِينَ is in the derivative form: مُرْدِفِين
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ر/د/ف   r–d–f backside, posterior, rump
; to come after, to follow, to come from the back, to come in succession, to ride behind someone; to stand in for, a ruler’s substitute; entourage.

Of this root, 3 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
رَدِفَ radifa; رَادِفَة rādifatun and مُرْدِفِين murdifın.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُرْدِفِين murdifın [pl. of act. part. مُرْدِف murdif] coming one after the other, in succession; causing others to come one after the other, or in succession

(8:9) أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُمْ بِأَلْفٍ مِنَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ I will reinforce you with a thousand angels, coming in succession.

entries.label: رَادِفَة
entries.definitionHtml:
رَادِفَة rādifatun [act. part. fem.] that which follows

(79:6–7) يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَة تَتْبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُ on the Day when the blast of the Trumpet reverberates and the second blast follows it.

entries.label: رَدَفَ
entries.definitionHtml:
رَدَفَ or رَدِفَ radifa/radafa a [v. intrans.] to come behind, to draw near, to be near at hand

(27:72) عَسَى أَنْ يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِي تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ maybe some of what you seek to hasten is near at hand.
